note: Situation spine v2 (docs/concepts/situation-spine.md). Three levels: domain / subdomain / situation. Each SITUATION leaf becomes exactly one golden path — a principle-layer row whose topic is domain/subdomain/slug. Built bottom-up from 527 candidates discovered by ten Opus scouts (docs/concepts/discovery/), semantically fused 496 -> 260. twoSided = a scout reported this situation has a half on the other side of the IPC boundary, so its golden path must document both. fusedAcrossSides = both halves were independently discovered and merged here.
